{"findings":[{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D12","page":1,"quote":"⌀ 16 H7 (+0.018/0)"},{"kind":"title_block","ref":"surface_treatment","page":1,"quote":"I.Z.B.P. (TRIVALENT)"}],"comment":"The ⌀16 H7 bore carries a tight ISO fit tolerance of 0.018 mm, but the part is zinc plated and no note or dimension accounts for plating buildup on this mating surface. The added coating thickness will shrink the hole below its H7 limit, risking interference with the mating shaft; the designer should either increase the bore size to allow for plating or add a note requiring masking or re-machining after plating."
    , "recommended_correction": "Increase the bore diameter before plating to compensate for the zinc layer, or specify that the bore be masked during I.Z.B.P. plating."}]}
